story.short_description: Orox, The Obsidian Anvil. An unstoppable force of nature and gravity.
story.long_description: Orox was not built; he was forged under the extreme pressure of a dying star during the Fracture. He is a colossal juggernaut clad in cracked obsidian plate armor laced with molten core energy. He does not dodge attacks; he absorbs them and strikes back with world-breaking force.
story.origin: Forged in the heart of a dying star during the Fracture
story.purpose: To serve as the immovable object against the unstoppable forces of the Void.
story.legacy: The heaviest and most durable Guardian in existence.

combat.combat_style: Unstoppable, earth-shattering area-of-effect strikes. He absorbs impacts and retaliates with devastating force.

personality.temperament: Immovable, silent, utterly destructive when provoked.
personality.strength: Unmatched durability and raw destructive power.
personality.weakness: Extremely slow, relying entirely on his armor to survive attacks.

important_events: The Cracking of the First World

art_direction.pose: Imposing, standing firm, holding a colossal warhammer resting on the ground.
art_direction.camera: Epic, low angle, looking up at a towering behemoth.
art_direction.environment: A dark, apocalyptic ruined city with a stormy, cloudy sky and golden lightning striking down.
art_direction.lighting: Dark shadows contrasted by intensely bright, glowing molten gold and amber energy.
art_direction.materials: Cracked obsidian, flowing molten gold, heavy dark cloth.
art_direction.scale: Massive, much larger than a normal human.
art_direction.art_direction_notes: The cracked obsidian armor must have glowing molten gold energy radiating from within.

lore.origin: Formed when the immense gravity of the Fracture crushed a star into a sentient suit of armor.
lore.history: Orox has never been defeated. He simply walks through enemy lines, obliterating them with sheer mass.
lore.purpose: To destroy the most heavily fortified Void strongholds.
lore.legend: When the ground shakes and the sky bleeds gold, Orox has arrived.
lore.current_mission: Walking the Molten Plains, waiting for a worthy target.
lore.secrets: His core is actually a miniature dying star.
quotes: "I do not break. I break the world."
lore.architect_notes: We did not create him. He created himself from the pressure of our mistakes.
